crossRefs.note: but you shall fear Yahweh, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm…
Only fear Yahweh, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for consider what great things he has done for you.
“Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor…
Who shouldn’t fear you, King of the nations? For it belongs to you. Because among all the wise men of the nations, and…
Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy…
His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.
Therefore you delivered them into the hand of their adversaries, who distressed them. In the time of their trouble…
salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;
to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,
in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

translations.web: But you shall fear Yahweh your God, and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.”
translations.bsb: but worship the LORD your God, and He will deliver you from the hands of all your enemies.”
translations.kjv: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
translations.asv: but Jehovah your God shall ye fear; and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
